name: vAssistant for Hubspot Chat using OpenAi and Airtable
description: This workflow integrates an OpenAI assistant with HubSpot Chat and Airtable to provide automated responses and manage customer interactions. It fetches chat messages, processes them with AI, and can store relevant information in Airtable.

setup: "Webhook" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value airtableBaseId: Airtable base id (for example appXXXX (from the base URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value airtableTableId: Airtable table id (for example tblXXXX (from the table URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Workflow secret HUBSPOT_TOKEN: HubSpot private app token for api.hubapi.com (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Workflow secret OPENAI_API_KEY: OpenAI API key for api.openai.com (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Workflow secret LISTAFIRME_API_KEY: www.listafirme.ro API key for www.listafirme.ro (query parameter key=<secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers, $json.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /hubspot-tinder). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"getHubspotMessage" authenticated with hubspotAppToken in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"OpenAi Create Thread" authenticated with openAiApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"OpenAI Run1" authenticated with openAiApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"OpenAI Run1": a request field used $('OtherNode'); on Yantra $() resolves via the named upstream map when that node ran earlier, else the immediate upstream - check that expression.
"OpenAI Run" authenticated with openAiApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).

"Repeat: Get Run" uses NodeRepeatUntil: carry each retry's state, return readiness through NEXT, and resume the selected exit only after onDone. Original interval waits are preserved. The attempt limit defaults to 30; adjust maxAttempts for the service or retry budget. Exhaustion stops with an error.
"Get Run" authenticated with openAiApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Get Last Message" authenticated with openAiApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).

notes:
Watch for new message on the chatbot. 
This can be triggered with [n8n chat widget](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@n8n/chat), hubspot or other chat services.
Post assistant Message back to chat service, in this case Hubspot
Create a new Thread, save it to database and RUN

Search for Thread ID in a database. 

This database is maintaing references between messaging service thread id and OpenI Thread ID.
POST a new message to existing thread.

Get Run Status:
If still in progress, run again. 
If action needed go to respective action.
If Completed, post message.

Run required actions based on Assistant answer and respond to Assistant with the function answer. 

Each route is a function that you need to define inside your assistant configuration.
